policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the SBLGNT reading.

decisions.evidence: κἂν is the crasis of καὶ ἐάν; ASV 'and if I have the gift of prophecy' renders either identically. No note is mapped here.
Same crasis alternation at the second clause; ASV 'and if I have all faith' does not distinguish καὶ ἐάν from κἂν.
μεθιστάναι and μεθιστάνειν are alternative present infinitive spellings of the same verb; ASV 'to remove mountains' renders both alike.
Crasis alternation only; ASV 'And if I bestow all my goods' renders καὶ ἐάν and κἂν identically. The verse's textual note concerns καυχήσωμαι, not this unit.
Crasis alternation at the second clause; ASV 'and if I give my body' does not distinguish the readings. The verse's note bears on the verb, not on this conjunction.

ASV text 'to be burned' renders καυθ-, and the mapped textual note 'Many ancient authorities read that I may glory' places καυχήσωμαι (r02) in the margin, so r02 is excluded from the text. Between καυθήσομαι (future indicative) and καυθήσωμαι (subjunctive) the English infinitive phrase decides nothing.
ASV repeats the subject: 'love envieth not; love vaunteth not itself', which requires the second ἡ ἀγάπη that r01 omits.
πίπτει and the compound ἐκπίπτει are both covered by ASV 'never faileth'; the prefix leaves no trace in the English.
ASV opens the verse 'For we know in part', an inferential/causal connective rendering γάρ; δέ would give 'but/and' or nothing.
ASV reads 'but when that which is perfect is come, that which is in part shall be done away' with no correlative 'then'; τότε of r01 is unrepresented.
The readings differ only in the position of ὡς νήπιος relative to its verbs; ASV 'I spake as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child' has the same three clauses under every arrangement.
ASV begins 'When I was a child' with no connective, but it routinely leaves a transitional δέ untranslated, so the absence does not exclude r01.
